name: Resource-Claiming Translation
description: Replaces the direct pairwise exclusion constraint (u and v cannot both be active) with an edge-based resource-claiming mechanism. Each active node must exclusively claim a resource (a fuse) located on each of its incident edges. This forces the model to deduce the pairwise exclusion through logical implication (two adjacent active nodes would both need the single fuse on their shared edge) rather than recognizing the standard phrasing of the Independent Set problem.
